rpc.note: Text and image prompts; arbitrary document/audio attachments are absent.
Equivalent prompt.streamingBehavior route; queue editing is separate and absent.
Native abort is sent; queue restoration/interrupt-and-resubmit are not exposed.
New chat works through bridge creation. The separate Session action sends new_session without reattaching/reloading the transcript.
No dedicated session-directory open control for this RPC; saved file selection uses switch_session instead.
Read RPCs are wired into normal GUI state.

rpc.surface: Composer model / thinking / supported Fast control
rpc.note: Fast is capability-gated. Model routes remain native.
Dedicated per-session controls.

rpc.surface: Saved chats / transcript / inline edit / reply branches
rpc.note: Native entries and saved-file switching are integrated. The current snapshot loader uses get_messages, not paged reads; large transport responses remain a gap.
Visible for active agents; live child conversation/steering UI is absent.
Dedicated native rename control.

rpc.surface: Checkpoint restore / inline edit / reply version continuation
rpc.note: No arbitrary tree picker, branch labels, custom summary instruction or summary abort UI.
Buttons exist, but the response is not used to open the forked session or expose/download the exported file.
Basic compaction is wired; customInstructions requires JSON. No model call was made in this audit.
Basic list/cancel is present. Refresh is snapshot-based; structured lifecycle/progress subscriptions are not integrated.
Plan/goal state is displayed. No direct goal lifecycle/budget control or todo editing/reordering/import/export interface.
OAuth URL/non-secret prompts are partly supported; native RPC rejects secret/pre-URL prompts. Automatic window.open can be blocked.
Provider names and signed-in state are queried; credentials stay on the server.

rpc.surface: JSON console only; Agents card shows snapshots
rpc.note: Subscription changes can be submitted but subagent_lifecycle/progress/event frames have no matching client presentation.
Bridge stays on v1 and has no rpc_chunk reassembly; large responses/events retain v1 limitations. Do not enable v2 until the decoder exists.
Tool UI is not enabled by the plain rpc bridge. The optional structured ask dialog is not negotiated or rendered.
Registration alone in JSON is insufficient: host_tool_call/cancel and host_uri_request/cancel are not serviced.
All six are absent from the cached catalog. Microphone/WebRTC/capture lifecycle, transcript insertion and mute/playback are not implemented.
Raw RPC entry only; no dedicated GUI workflow. Event-driven results (notably btw, bash and subagent work) lack a matching live view. JSON query results can be inspected.

cli.note: Native usage statistics plus read-only host supplements.
All 615 global keys are listed, but 23 enum rows lack choices in normal controls. Raw config.yml is a fallback; project/profile scope has no dedicated manager.
Catalog, roles and custom providers exist; native refresh and account/model diagnostics are not equivalent.
Install/remove/enable/disable/upgrade, marketplace and diagnostics subset. Not every native plugin CLI option.
Installs/connects OMP and opens providers. Does not expose all native optional dependency/onboarding setup actions.
Task agent overrides can be configured; no dedicated bundled-agent inventory/editor.
Normal chat navigation exists; pack/unpack/moved/lease transfer workflows do not.

cli.surface: Related slash commands can be entered
cli.note: Not a full CLI management workflow. Slash text output is dropped; CLI-only options/services are not handled.
Native terminal previews/replay/shell completions are intentionally outside the graphical host.
An agent may use related tools, and some related config keys exist. That is not equivalent to exposing this CLI command in the GUI.

features.name: Tool questions
features.note: OmpBridge hardcodes --mode rpc; upstream rpc-ui enables tool UI. A React select dialog alone does not make the native ask tool usable. rpc-ui also disables PTY, so shell behavior needs acceptance when changing modes.

features.name: Slash output and native notices
features.note: command_output and notice frames are discarded by chatReducer. Commands can run with no visible answer or error.

features.name: Dialog cancellation and selection fidelity
features.note: cancel does not remove targetId; initialIndex/checkedIndices/checkbox markers/option descriptions are dropped; input secret hints are not propagated.

features.name: Extension composer updates
features.note: set_editor_text displays a notice but does not put the supplied text into the composer.

features.name: Lossless large RPC frames
features.note: No negotiate_protocol/v2 decoder, and snapshot.ts uses unpaged get_messages. Large history/tool/extension payloads retain protocol-v1 limits.

features.name: Goal lifecycle and task editing
features.note: Display-only task plan is good; start/pause/resume/clear/budget and editable todos still need controls.

features.name: Queue management
features.note: Steer/follow-up and queued chips exist, but withdraw/promote/edit/restore operations require manual JSON.

features.name: Subagent conversations and steering
features.note: Agent list/cancel exists; child transcripts, steering and lifecycle/progress subscriptions need dedicated integration.

features.name: Export/fork/tree completion
features.note: Export path and fork result are ignored; tree navigation is limited to checkpoints/reply versions.

features.name: Provider accounts and MCP authentication
features.note: Provider logout/account selection are console-only. MCP config/probe exists, but upstream RPC does not install interactive MCP authentication handling.

features.name: Settings reachability versus effect
features.note: 615 global fields are listed; 23 enum controls have no choices, 165 fields lack UI metadata, and 167 have no tab category. TUI-only fields and RPC defaults also limit the effect of configuration.

features.name: Launch flags
features.note: Launch flags are split on whitespace, so quoted paths/arguments are not preserved. Interactive/print/output-mode flags cannot be counted as working RPC features merely because the text box accepts them.

features.name: Voice and dictation
features.note: No microphone/WebRTC/session/capture/mute UI or voice/dictation event consumers. Speech-related settings/model roles do not provide that workflow.

features.name: Word completion and side questions
features.note: No predict_word ghost text/feedback or btw streaming/history view. Project suggestions are a different host feature.

features.name: Host-owned tools and virtual URIs
features.note: No request dispatch, cancellation, update/result or URI read/write responder. Raw JSON registration alone can leave requests unanswered.

features.name: Native CLI services and administration
features.note: No profile manager, session transfer, skill registry installation/publishing, native updater/dependency installer, provider quota view, auth broker, process console or full Git UI.

features.name: Extension terminal components
features.note: Native component factories/custom header/footer/editor/raw input/autocomplete/theme APIs are terminal-only. They require an adapter or an explicitly retained terminal workflow.
